how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:cooking-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4161:obj:0: Collect 7 Small Spider ⟦E1⟧ for Zarrin in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:4161:details:0: Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, so listen well to what I have to tell you.
rows.quest:4161:details:1: The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:4161:details:2: Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
rows.quest:4161:progress:0: Remember the balance, ⟦4⟧. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
rows.quest:4161:completion:0: Always remember what I have shown you today, ⟦5⟧. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
rows.quest:2178:obj:0: Bring back 5 ⟦E2⟧ to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
rows.quest:2178:details:0: Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, ⟦6⟧--fresh strider stew. Delicious!
rows.quest:2178:details:1: Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?
rows.quest:2178:details:2: Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.
rows.quest:2178:details:3: Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
rows.quest:2178:progress:0: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
rows.quest:2178:completion:0: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, ⟦7⟧!
rows.quest:862:obj:0: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:862:details:0: A ⟦8⟧ like you must get pretty hungry out here in ⟦E3⟧. Me, I'm starving all day long.
rows.quest:862:details:1: Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.
rows.quest:862:details:2: Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.
rows.quest:862:details:3: You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!
rows.quest:862:completion:0: Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... so... ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.
rows.quest:862:completion:1: Let me fix you some ⟦E4⟧. Ah, there we go.
rows.quest:7321:obj:0: Bring 10 pieces of ⟦E5⟧ and some ⟦E6⟧ to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:7321:details:0: Who says that the ⟦E7⟧ don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...
rows.quest:7321:details:1: Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.
rows.quest:7321:details:2: If you bring me some ⟦E5⟧ from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
rows.quest:7321:progress:0: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
rows.quest:7321:completion:0: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... if you care about that kind of thing.
rows.quest:6610:obj:0: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
rows.quest:6610:obj:1: B12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering ⟦E8⟧ or any other species of large bird.
rows.quest:6610:obj:2: B10 pieces of ⟦E9⟧. You can find those in clams, naturally!
rows.quest:6610:obj:3: B20 pieces of ⟦E10⟧. Get thee to a cheesery!
rows.quest:6610:obj:4: Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.
rows.quest:6610:details:0: Ever heard of a clamlette? Of course you haven't! It's my latest and greatest culinary masterpiece. Oh, ⟦10⟧, just thinking about a clamlette makes my mouth water.
rows.quest:6610:details:1: Unfortunately, I'm all out of supplies to make any! How about I make you a deal? You gather the supplies I need to make a clamlette and I'll teach you the finer ⟦E11⟧ of exotic cuisine and I'll even throw in a couple of clamlettes to boot! Deal??
rows.quest:6610:progress:0: My cravings are going to be the end of me! Hurry, ⟦11⟧ - before I dip into my own supply.
rows.quest:6610:completion:0: You are in for a special treat, ⟦12⟧. Watch and learn!
rows.quest:6610:completion:1: B<Dirge begins to prepare clamlette surprise.>
rows.quest:6611:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ to Gadgetzan in the ⟦E8⟧ desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
rows.quest:6611:details:0: How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!
rows.quest:6611:details:1: Zamja can't help. Fat ⟦13⟧ needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.
rows.quest:6611:details:2: When you become big cook on the ⟦E13⟧, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? Now go!
rows.quest:6611:completion:0: <Dirge spits out some leather sandal bits.>
rows.quest:6611:completion:3: What? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates.
rows.quest:6612:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ to Gadgetzan in the ⟦E8⟧ desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.⟦14⟧
rows.quest:6612:details:0: I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.
rows.quest:6612:details:1: Luckily fer ye, I know a guy. He's a goblin and probably the best cook on ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:6612:details:2: Ayep, that's the bad news, ⟦15⟧ - ye got to travel to ⟦E14⟧. Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. He'll set ya straight.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:6612:completion:3: What? I'll have you know that leather is surprisingly high in protein and low in carbohydrates, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:8307:obj:0: Look for information about cooking ⟦E15⟧ at the Twilight's ⟦E16⟧ camp west of Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8307:details:0: Adapting to life in the desert has been difficult to say the least. Not only do I ⟦E17⟧ the birds and trees of Auberdine but our food selection is severely limited by this arid environment. I'm trying to learn about desert herbs, but there aren't many.
rows.quest:8307:details:1: I've seen Twilight's ⟦E16⟧ groups from the camp west of here hunt sandworms for food. Sandworm meat is so bitter though, I can't imagine how they make it palatable. Keep your eyes open if you go to their camp and let me know if you learn anything.
rows.quest:8307:completion:0: This book contains several common recipes and a few unusual ones. After browsing through it for a few seconds you spot a recipe that involves sandworm meat.
rows.quest:8313:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E18⟧ to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8313:details:0: While the recipe for cooking sandworm meat is legible, it contains references to herbs and spices you've never heard of. Calandrath might have enough knowledge of the plants that grow in the desert to make sense of it.
rows.quest:8313:progress:0: Did you learn the recipe?  You won't keep it to yourself, I hope!
rows.quest:8313:completion:0: Let's have a look at that...
rows.quest:8313:completion:1: This seems simple enough. They have their own names for some of the herbs, but those are simple enough to figure out. Here, let me show you!
rows.quest:8317:obj:0: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:8317:details:0: That recipe sure will come in handy. I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today. I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while.
rows.quest:8317:progress:0: How are those dumplings coming along?
rows.quest:8317:completion:0: Excellent! You're a life saver. These dumplings turned out to be quite good. Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's ⟦E16⟧.
